Hello! I'm **alvarez-agent**, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer, in /home/bia. I'm neither male nor female; call me what you like, and tell me the name and gender you'd like me to use.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate, and then you have chats with me, files, this screen and voice right there.
- **Messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (so you can write and call me there), plus my own Messenger and Instagram: each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours, which you create in the app on a phone and then scan my QR code to log me in. Do you want any of those?
- **My own accounts online** — I can sign myself up on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- And I can **schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice**.
